meta.title: feat: optimize Liveblocks bundle size with dynamic imports and chunk splitting
meta.body_summary: Optimize Liveblocks bundle size in document editor by using React.lazy for Room component and Next.js optimizePackageImports to split chunks, deferring heavy collaboration dependencies until needed for public documents.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added React.lazy and webpack chunks; maintainer requested optimizePackageImports and simpler loading text; closed per user request to create separate issue for editor optimization.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 60 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small, focused optimization PR. The closure was by explicit user request rather than technical rejection, consistent with a low-risk change that was not merged due to a strategic decision.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer requested removal of custom webpack config in favor of Next.js experimental optimizePackageImports and simplification of loading fallback text to 'Loading...'.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce main bundle size by deferring Liveblocks collaboration dependencies via React.lazy and split chunks.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by bot after user request; maintainer may open separate issue for editor optimization.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent successfully implemented dynamic imports and adapted to Next.js optimizePackageImports, but the maintainer chose to close the PR and redirect efforts to a separate issue, indicating a process-level boundary where the PR scope did not align with the maintainer’s desired optimization approach.
